command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- /app ---'
ls -la /app 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- /data tree ---'
find /data -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- source_a head ---'
head -c 4000 /data/source_a/users.json 2>/dev/null || true
printf '\n%s\n' '--- source_b head ---'
head -n 20 /data/source_b/users.csv 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- python/package check ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
print(sys.version)
for mod in ['pandas','pyarrow','fastparquet']:
    try:
        m=__import__(mod)
        print(mod, getattr(m,'__version__','available'))
    except Exception as e:
        print(mod, 'MISSING', e)
PY

command:
set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
p='/data/source_c/users.parquet'
df=pd.read_parquet(p)
print('source_c shape:', df.shape)
print('source_c dtypes:')
print(df.dtypes.to_string())
print('source_c records:')
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print('to_dict records:', df.to_dict(orient='records'))
PY
